customer_ops: Hey team — we pinned our embedding model to a dedicated variant yesterday and now our similarity scores are totally off. Old vectors were 1536, new ones are coming back 1024. This broke nearest-neighbor lookups. Anyone seen this before?

hayden_support: Sorry for the disruption. Can you share a failing request id and a short curl you used? Also which pin name did you use?

customer_ops: req-0ab12f3c. Pin name is `embed-anchor-prod-v2` (we pinned via the Console under Projects > Model pins). Sample curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-anchor-prod-v2","input":"test string"}'
```

hayden_support: Thanks. Can you paste the response you got (or just the embedding length)?

customer_ops: Response snippet:

```json
{"data": [{"embedding": [0.001, 0.002, ...], "index": 0}], "usage": {}}
```

Embedding length is 1024 on all recent calls. Our training and index assume 1536 so a lot of items don't match.

opsbot: Deploy event: variant `embed-anchor-prod-v2` rolled out to 3 nodes in us-west-2 at 2026-03-07T15:07:12Z (deployment id: deploy-7823).

mike_infra: @hayden_support @jenna_ml looking at deploy logs — the canary for embed-anchor-prod-v2 was wired to a new model artifact labeled `embed-anchor-quant` that was intended to be a smaller-footprint variant; its output dims are 1024. It looks like the Console pin accidentally pointed to that artifact.

hayden_support: Oof. That's probably the cause. customer_ops, did you select a variant by artifact name or by the UI pin?

customer_ops: I used the Console pin dropdown (we thought it was the stable entry). We didn't select an artifact manually.

jenna_ml: Two quick notes: 1) embeddings dimensions are part of the model contract — switching artifacts can change vector size, 2) we should have validated pin targets at pin time and warned about dimension mismatch. I'll file a postmortem item.

mike_infra: For immediate mitigation I can do a rollback of the pin to the previous artifact that returns 1536. If you want, we can also create a compatibility alias that maps the old name to the 1536 artifact. Which do you prefer?

customer_ops: Rollback please. We need index correctness ASAP. Can you also provide a list of affected requests in the last 24h so we can decide whether to reindex?

hayden_support: Rolling back now — will update when complete. Also creating support ticket INC-24671 for request harvesting.

opsbot: Pin rollback initiated for `embed-anchor-prod-v2` (rollback id rb-331).

mike_infra: Rollback finished at 2026-03-07T15:21:45Z. `embed-anchor-prod-v2` now points to artifact `embed-anchor-v1` (dims=1536).

customer_ops: Confirmed on our side — embeddings are back to length 1536 and our index queries look normal. Thanks.

hayden_support: Really sorry about the blast radius. Next steps: we will (1) run a quick scan to surface all pins whose artifact dims differ from the project / index expectation, (2) add a Console warning when pin targets change embedding size, and (3) share the list of request ids around req-0ab12f3c in INC-24671.

jenna_ml: Adding a note for product: require an explicit confirmation when a pin changes model output shape and add a diff view in the Console.

customer_ops: Appreciate the fast rollback and the follow-ups. Please post the request list to the ticket.

hayden_support: Will do — closing thread for now and tracking in INC-24671 / followup PRs. :white_check_mark:
